title: 얼어붙은 뿌리
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 8, take B. NIFLHEIM: an ICE CAVERN and the ancient FROZEN WORLD-TREE ROOT beneath visible AURORA light. Take B: a huge forked woody root lies diagonally through a translucent central ice ridge, its main fork rising at x50% from a low frozen basin. Bark ridges unmistakably woody, long icicles and deep cyan frost encase the wood. This is a wide view across the cavern, not close-up; the root and ridge together form one middle-third landmark, a low distant frozen lake horizon at y72%. Broad faceted cave ceiling arches overhead. Green aurora visible through a cleft at upper left casts cool light on the left root surfaces. Palette deep teal, desaturated cyan, blue-grey and a small green aurora accent. Calm dark edges and simple silhouettes. No snake, face, eyes, creature, runic band, seal, symbol, text, figures or frames. LAYOUT PRIORITY over the reference compositions: references supply style and realm identity only. Do NOT repeat their tall busy edge islands or high skyline. Keep the distant horizon unmistakably at y=75% of frame height, leaving the top 70% broad quiet atmospheric space interrupted only by the SINGLE central landmark. All secondary distant ground details remain below y=70%. No elaborate foreground objects at the edges. Main landmark base at y=76%, top near y=28%, visual centre x=50%. Calm outer 8 pixels after downscale.
